items.title: 5.6 Bigre materials mein strain energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6 with Figs. 5.6 and 5.7 (PDF 99-100).

blocks.text: Jab jism force se bigre to elastic wapas lane wali force ke khilaf kaam hota hai. Yeh jism mein us ki potential energy ke taur par mehfooz hota hai aur jism ke molecules ki apni darmiyani jagahon se hatne ki wajah se un ki potential energy ke izafe ke barabar hai.
Khinche material mein mehfooz energy ke expression ki derivation

Spring ki shakal mein material lein (Fig. 5.6) jo force F se extension x tak khincha jata hai. Chunke elastic limit ke andar extension kheenchne wali force ke seedhe tanasub mein hai, force sifr se F tak yaksan taur par barhti hai (Fig. 5.7); yun spring ko delta x tak kheenchne wali ausat force (1/2) F hai. Is liye kheenchne wali force ka kiya kaam = ausat force x force ki simt mein faasla: W = (1/2) F x delta x ... (5.7). Hooke ke qanoon se F = k (delta x), is liye W = ((1/2) k delta x)(delta x) = (1/2) k (delta x)^2, ya W = OPQ ka raqba. Kheenchne wali force ka kiya kaam spring mein us ki strain energy ke taur par mehfooz hota hai aur us ke molecules mein mehfooz potential energy ke barabar hai: jism mein mehfooz strain energy = E = (1/2) F delta x = (1/2) k (delta x)^2. Material kheenchne mein kiya kaam lagai ausat force zarb chala faasla ke barabar hai, to force-extension graph ke neeche ka raqba material kheenchne ka kaam zahir karta hai, jo us mein mehfooz elastic PE ke barabar bhi hai (For Your Information).

blocks.alt: Ufqi support se do springs latakte hain. Baen spring apni asal lambai par hai (Original length of spring). Daen spring par slotted weights ka bojh hai aur woh lamba hai; do ufqi lakeeron ke darmiyan teer baen spring ke sire se neeche us ka extension x dikhate hain. Bojh ke saath teer F neeche ki taraf hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Asal lambai ka spring force F se extension x tak khincha hua (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Force F ka extension delta x ke muqable graph, origin O se. Seedhi lakeer O se force F par P tak uthti hai; dashed lakeer P ko F-axis se jorti hai aur nuqtedar lakeer P se extension axis par Q tak girti hai. Tikon (triangle) OPQ surmai rang mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Force F ka extension delta x ke muqable graph; rangeen tikon OPQ (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force sifr se F tak barabar barhti hai, is liye ausat force F/2 hai. Tikon OPQ ka raqba = (1/2) x F x delta x, jo spring ko khenchne mein kiya gaya kaam aur us mein mehfooz energy hai.

Farz karein A lambai L ke material ka cross-sectional raqba aur delta L extension hai; to material ka volume A L hai. Material ki fi unit volume strain energy U = (1/2) (F x delta L) / (A x L), ya U = (1/2) x (F/A) x (delta L / L) ... (5.8), ya U = (1/2) x stress x strain ... (5.9). Young's modulus ki equation (Eq. 5.6) se F/A = Y x delta L / L; ise Eq. 5.8 mein rakhne par fi unit volume strain energy U = (1/2) Y x (delta L / L) x (delta L / L) = (1/2) Y (delta L / L)^2 ... (5.10). Yeh equation material par stress lagne par us mein mehfooz strain energy nikalne ko istemal hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Strain energy
rows: W = (1/2) F delta x = (1/2) k (delta x)^2 = F ke muqable delta x lakeer ke neeche OPQ ka raqba (5.7)

blocks.prompt: 200 N m^-1 constant ki spring 0.5 m khinchi jati hai; mehfooz elastic PE nikalein (numerical 5.2). Mehfooz energy F delta x ke hasil-e-zarb ka aadha kyun hai, poora kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: E = (1/2) k x^2 = (1/2) x 200 x 0.25 = 25 J. Force mustaqil nahi: spring khinchne ke saath yeh sifr se F tak barhti hai, to poori extension par sirf ausat force F/2 lagti hai, jo force-extension lakeer ke neeche triangle dikhata hai.

items: Wapas lane wali force ke khilaf kaam strain (elastic potential) energy ke taur par mehfooz. Spring: ausat force F/2, W = (1/2) F delta x = (1/2) k (delta x)^2 = OPQ ka raqba. Fi unit volume U = (1/2) stress x strain = (1/2) Y (delta L/L)^2.
